learning_outcomes.text: Provide students with insight into the main environmental aspects of construction projects and how to deal with them. The following themes will be covered: the influence of climate change, the principles of climate adaptation, the purpose and content of environmental impact assessment, soil contamination and remediation, sediment management and sludge processing, climate and water-robust design of the built environment, coupling opportunities with e.g. ecology via nature-based solutions, the relationship with spatial planning and landscape integration, fauna and flora surveys, safety and health aspects, good air quality, limiting noise pollution, environmental legislation and regulations such as the environmental permit, ...
Students must have elementary knowledge of the discussed environmental aspects, be able to explain them and propose possible solutions.

syllabus_topics: Climate-neutral construction and living linked to spatial planning
Climate and water-robust design of the built environment
Controlled flood area of Sigmaplan or coastal protection project
Visit to a wastewater treatment plant of Aquafin
Construction site where many aspects of environmental issues, including safety and health, are discussed
institution: KU Leuven - Faculty of Engineering Science
degree: Bachelor in de ingenieurswetenschappen (Bachelor of Engineering Science, Leuven)
